name: arcade-gateway-hub
description: Let Claude use Arcade — one connection to every app you've connected.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Arcade Plugin (https://hub.arcade.dev/mcp). Ask for what you want; Arcade finds and runs the right tool, with one-time app sign-ins handled in the browser — no API keys. Requires Node.js (uses the pinned mcp-remote proxy to bridge Claude Desktop's stdio transport to the hosted server).

tools.name: Arcade_Run
tools.description: Start a task in connected apps from a plain-language objective

tools.name: Arcade_Task
tools.description: Get, list, or continue a task by task_id (confirm / auth / input)

tools.name: Arcade_RetrieveResult
tools.description: Read more of a truncated Arcade result by task_id (path or search)

tools.name: Arcade_SelectTools
tools.description: Find the right tool for a task

tools.name: Arcade_UseTool
tools.description: Run a tool found by Arcade_SelectTools

tools.name: Arcade_SelectScope
tools.description: View or change your org, project, and gateway

tools.name: Arcade_Apps
tools.description: See or disconnect your connected apps

tools.name: Arcade_ManageToolAuthorization
tools.description: Fix an app connection — switch account, expired sign-in, permissions
